Leading to Reading Volunteers

Through the assistance of adult and teen volunteers, Leading to Reading strives to turn reading and learning into a fun and positive experience.

Under the supervision and guidance of Leading to Reading staff, volunteers meet with an assigned child at the library for a one hour weekly scheduled session to further develop their literacy skills.

Please note that volunteer hours qualify towards the 40 hours of community service graduation requirement for Ontario high school students.
